    assert status == 201
    assert user["name"] == "Bob"
    assert user["email"] == "bob@example.com"
    assert "id" in user
    
    # Verify retrieval
    status, retrieved = handle_get_user({"id": str(user["id"])})
    assert status == 200
    assert retrieved == user

def test_create_user_invalid_name():
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "", "email": "bob@example.com"})
    assert status == 400
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": " " * 51, "email": "bob@example.com"})
    assert status == 400

def test_create_user_invalid_email():
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "invalid"})
    assert status == 400

def test_create_user_duplicate_email():
    handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"})
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "Bob2", "email": "BOB@example.com"})
    assert status == 409
